_comment: Hidden mechanics of 1.3.2 (docs/HIDDEN_MECHANICS.md). Nothing here is ever shown as a list in game, sold or rolled for money. 'unfolds': extra, secret unfold paths read by HiddenMechanics.unfold_targets (Spirling.unfurl_targets); 'to' must already be a normal unfold target of 'from', so Furl back keeps working. 'spawns': rare wild Spirlings of one map that only step out while 'when' holds (HiddenMechanics.maybe_spawn, called by the encounter code); without min/max the map table's rings are used. 'spots': hidden things on a map cell: 'at' tile (a solid cell nothing else answers), landmark or sign (after the normal text). 'times': presses needed; 'code': a word written at the sign; 'action' knack or echo. 'battle': deterministic damage and crit touches, only in world battles (BattleModel.hidden_rules), never in league, live duel, raid or echo battles. 'knack': each Spirling's favourite sky, worked out from its uid (no save field). 'when' keys: phase (dawn/day/dusk/night), weather (clear/rain/fog/wind/storm), moon (full/new, Berlin calendar day), weekday (0 Sunday .. 6), date (MM-DD, Berlin), chain (Gleam chain at least), ring, held, kinship, knows (art name), map, lead_element.

spawns.line: Moonlight pools in the ferns. Something quiet steps out...
Rain hammers the canal. A shimmer rises out of the spray...
The dusk fog thickens into a shape...
Your long search stirred the locks. Something new surfaces...
The stars turn above the ridge. A small orbit drifts down...
Under the full moon the marsh hums. A moth of light lands...
Sunday dawn, frost on everything. An owl calls once...
The wind lifts the sand. Something leaps through the gusts...

taps: A lone tree. Old marks are scratched into the bark.
You knock on the trunk. Something rattles inside.
lines: You knock a third time. A hollow opens, and something drops out!
after: Just a tree now. It seems a little lighter.

lines: Between the Crowcrest Cairn and the cliff, one stone is loose. Something is wedged under it!
after: Only moss behind the cairn now.

lines: In the dark, the old beacon blinks: slow, slow, quick.
A keeper's note is nailed below: 'If the quay ever asks, answer LANTERN.'

taps: Under the sign, someone scratched a row of empty boxes.
lines: The boards click. A drawer slides out of the post!
Tucked behind the Quay Heron: a fisher's lost lens.
after: Gull feathers behind the heron. Nothing else.

lines: In the fog, the salt behind the Needle glows. You brush it away and find something.

taps: The founder's mask sits a little crooked.
lines: You push the mask straight. Behind it, a word is cut into the stone: TALLOW.

taps: Under the sign, someone scratched a row of empty boxes.
lines: The lamp above flares once. Candles roll out of a hidden shelf!
You look into the Star Well. Your team's reflections ripple.

taps: You call into the well. Only silence.
lines: You call once more... and the well answers: '{name}... {name}... {name}...'
after: The well hums your name, very softly.

taps: The chapel lamp gutters. Something glints in the wax.
lines: The wax gives way. A leaf, still green, was sealed inside!
Your Spirling breathes on the old fence. Frost draws a stamp, and a charm drops from a crack!

code_wrong: Nothing happens. The boxes stay empty.

words.clear: %s: its reflection is brightest under a wide, open sky.
words.rain: %s: its reflection is brightest when rain drums on the roofs.
words.fog: %s: its reflection is brightest when the world goes soft and grey.
words.wind: %s: its reflection is brightest when the wind pulls at the grass.
words.storm: %s: its reflection is brightest when thunder walks the hills.

dates.line: The longest night of the year. Somewhere, every lamp in Veydal burns a little longer.
First day of spring. The ferns of Fernstair seem to lean toward you.
